target: Unmodified G0 qbl JAGS source, SHA-256 f8360126424b7a463f76a1c99efc89a8a5cb81339213bd4931559f14595fbab6; JAGS 4.3.2 required
scope: n<=8; enumeration N=1,2,3; no national fitting; conditioned auxiliary contrasts labeled separately

deterministic_cases.observations: all integer A,W in 0:N, flag A+W>N independently

runtime_probes: invalid active class 2 counts in data
invalid inactive class 1 counts in data
invalid active class 3 counts in data
invalid inactive class 2 chi counts in data

generator.policy: record every attempt, no clamp/redraw/truncation; explicit failure if invalid probability or physical support

comparison.case: N=1,A=0,W=0; fixed continuous effects and coefficients; pi auxiliaries fixed; exact posterior over Z and four counts
comparison.failure_policy: retain output; do not increase iterations/tolerances; diagnostic failure means inconclusive

decision_rules.generator: if any failure or incomplete literal support, T1 not done/pass
decision_rules.engine: JAGS may remain literal software reference; no exact Stan equivalence claim
decision_rules.gate: executor supplies candidate only; independent review and coordination decide pass
